# F5 contract: the infra helpers (subprocess + passthrough-exec + mmap + state
# reader). These are foundations with no CLI surface yet (F6+ consume them), so
# the contract is the unit-test binary, which covers:
#
#   1. parse_size: <number>[K|M|G|T] -> bytes (fractional truncation, icase).
#   2. exec_passthrough: forwards the child's exit code (the fast/cycle
#      transparent-passthrough mechanism).
#   3. run_process: kills a child at the timeout; captures a fast child's stdout.
#   4. read_state_file: reads mcycle/minstret from a known-good hybrid_state_v1
#      and rejects bad-magic / wrong-size / missing files.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

INFRATEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-infra-test"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

# 1-4. the infra unit tests carry the whole F5 contract
[ -x "$INFRATEST" ] || fail "missing infra unit-test binary: $INFRATEST"
"$INFRATEST" || fail "infra unit tests failed"

ok "F5 infra"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# --mem-size contract: one model-neutral flag, per-model semantics.
#
#   fast:   forwards a plain `-m` only when given (QEMU as-is otherwise);
#           QEMU itself validates the 2 GiB AE350 DRAM window.
#   hybrid: sizes the shared mmap (= QEMU backend = vsim window); the driver
#           caps at 2G BEFORE allocating the backing file.
#   cycle:  validate-only (the engine always models its full DRAM window).
#   --mmap-size stays as a hidden alias of --mem-size.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/vplat_hello.elf"        # engine-portable (fast/cycle)
MELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf"        # carries ROI markers (hybrid)

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
[ -f "$ELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $ELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"
[ -f "$MELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $MELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"

# 1. fast + --mem-size 1G: forwarded -m accepted, program still runs.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1G "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 1G rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "hello from vplat" \
  || fail "fast --mem-size 1G lost program output:"$'\n'"$out"

# 2. fast + --mem-size 4G: QEMU itself rejects (as-is validation).
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 4G "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1) \
  && fail "fast --mem-size 4G should fail:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -qi "cannot model more than" \
  || fail "fast 4G failure should be QEMU's own DRAM-window error:"$'\n'"$out"

# 3. fast + a size that is not a whole MiB: driver rejects before spawning.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1000 "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 1000 rc=$rc (want 2):"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "whole MiB" || fail "missing MiB-granularity hint:"$'\n'"$out"

# 4. hybrid + --mem-size 4G: early driver cap, no mmap file allocated.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 4G "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "hybrid --mem-size 4G rc=$rc (want 2):"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "AE350 DRAM window" || fail "missing 2G cap message:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\]" \
  && fail "hybrid 4G must fail BEFORE allocating the mmap:"$'\n'"$out"

# 5. hybrid + --mem-size 256M: sized mmap + the run completes.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 256M "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid --mem-size 256M rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\] 256.0 MiB" \
  || fail "mmap status line should show 256.0 MiB:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "window_cycles" || fail "no cycle figure:"$'\n'"$out"

# 6. the retired --mmap-size spelling still works (hidden alias).
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mmap-size 192M "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "--mmap-size alias rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\] 192.0 MiB" \
  || fail "alias should size the mmap to 192.0 MiB:"$'\n'"$out"

# 7. cycle + --mem-size: validated, declared a no-op, run still passes.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 64M "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle --mem-size 64M rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "nothing to size" \
  || fail "cycle should say --mem-size has nothing to size:"$'\n'"$out"

ok "--mem-size contract (fast as-is, hybrid capped mmap, cycle no-op, alias)"
